messages:
ana (product): Heads-up: we need final dependency owners for the tiered launch by Fri EOD. Major asks: per-tenant prewarm opt-in, tighter p95 for paid tier, and audit-ready traces.

ricardo (eng-runtime): Runtime needs workload shapes for paid tier to validate p95 claims. If median tokens > 1k, p95 work increases non-linearly. Need those numbers ASAP.

tara (infra): Per-tenant prewarm is doable as opt-in add-on. Cost impact depends on reservation length; finance wants a 30/90-day delta. Also need prewarm API shape frozen.

mina (security): KMS onboarding + telemetry retention toggles will take ~3w. If customers need immediate compliance, we must prioritize SOC2 dataflow review now.

sam (eng-platform): I'll draft a short dependency contract with owners, SLA, rollback triggers, and a simple circuit-breaker. Will PR by Thu.

ci-bot: ci-bot created issue PROJ-9071 for dep-contract draft assigned to sam. :gear:

ana (product): Action: ana share workload docs today; ricardo run perf sims by Wed; tara post cost+reservation options by Thu; mina start compliance checklist. Wed 9am sync to confirm.

ricardo (eng-runtime): Quick note: runtime wants prewarm API limited to on/off + target_concurrency to avoid churn.

tara (infra): Agreed. Freeze prewarm surface to those fields for GA.

mina (security): OK. Smaller API makes audit easier.

ana (product): Great. If anyone can't meet dates ping here. Thanks everyone.
